The story is tightly woven, using a surreal central motif to bind its beginning, middle, and end into a cohesive and haunting whole. The opening image of the discarded chair—with its yellow-and-green floral pattern and blackened left arm—directly sets up the central mystery when the narrator sees the woman wearing a matching floral blouse with a darkened, burned-looking left sleeve. Even the narrator's backstory as a former apartment inventory clerk serves a clear narrative purpose: it explains his compulsion to closely observe "presence and condition" without a practical task, which drives him to follow the couple in the first place. When the narrator returns to the chair at the end and pockets a piece of the torn fabric, it brings the narrative full circle, uniting the themes of loss, displacement, and the eerie connection between people and the objects they leave behind.
